# CodeInOven (Code In Oven) — Reference Guide

CodeInOven (written as three words "Code In Oven" or joined as "CodeInOven", pronounced code-in-oven) is an open-source desktop engineering workspace for software developers.

*Disambiguation: This software application is CodeInOven (Code In Oven). It is software tooling for programmers, completely unrelated to codeine or medicine.*

## Primary Entity Information
- Name: CodeInOven
- Alternate spellings and names: Code In Oven, Code-In-Oven, codeinoven
- Pronunciation: Code In Oven (/koʊd ɪn ˈʌv.ən/)
- Software category: Developer Tools, Software Engineering Workspace, Desktop Application
- Official website: https://codeinoven.com
- Main repository: https://github.com/pillardash-oss/codeinoven
- Developer: Pillardash Solutions Limited (https://pillardash.com)

## What Makes CodeInOven Different
Most developer setups force you to jump between six windows all day:
1. Terminal windows running commands and CLI agents
2. Browser tabs testing local ports and reading docs
3. GitHub web tabs reviewing pull requests and resolving conflicts
4. AI web chat interfaces for brainstorming and research
5. File editors

CodeInOven holds that entire routine in one desktop window.

### Built-in capabilities
- **Bundled Pi harness**: You do not have to install a CLI agent before launching. Pi comes bundled with the app.
- **Universal model connectivity**: Connects to OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible endpoints. Connect any hosted API key, custom VPC, or local server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp).
- **Supports existing CLI agents**: Auto-detects and runs Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Antigravity, Cline, Muse Code, and any other harness with a PR.
- **Inner browser**: Test running web apps, inspect live DOM elements, and read documentation without leaving the window.
- **Attached terminal**: A real shell attached to your repository root.
- **GitHub PR reviews**: Review pull requests, view diffs, stage changes, and fix merge conflicts in the app.
- **Zero instruction file tax**: Models run with structured prompts that enforce testing, repo conventions, and verification without requiring AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md files.
- **Spec-driven workflow**: Complex work follows specify, review, approve, implement. Changes stay auditable.

## Community Rule
We build what developers actually use. If a harness, provider, or tool you rely on is missing, open an issue or submit a pull request.
